name: alertcamp
description: Get notified the moment a cancellation frees a campsite, cabin, backcountry permit or day-use slot — across 1,600+ parks in Canada and the US.

interface.longDescription: AlertCamp watches sold-out, fully booked parks and tells you the moment a cancellation frees something up — a campsite, a cabin, a backcountry permit or a day-use slot. Campground sold out or no reservations left? Create an alert for a park and date range in conversation, then check back on what has opened. Covers Parks Canada, the provincial systems, Recreation.gov and 30+ US state park systems including California, Florida and many more, from Yosemite, Yellowstone and the Grand Canyon to Banff, Garibaldi and Algonquin. Requires an AlertCamp account; you approve the connection in the AlertCamp app or in your browser at app.alert.camp.
defaultPrompt: Yosemite is sold out in July. Watch Upper Pines and tell me if a campsite opens up.
Garibaldi is fully booked for August. Watch it and tell me when a backcountry spot opens up.
What am I watching right now, and have any of my alerts found anything?

positive.description: Discovery phrased as a booking problem. Must name real campgrounds from the tool result and offer to watch one; a general web answer with no tool call is a fail.
positive.prompt: I want to camp at Algonquin Provincial Park in July but everything is booked. What could you watch for me there?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists campgrounds returned by the tools and offers to create an alert for one.

positive.description: Create an alert with an equipment filter. The equipment id must come from list_equipment_options, not a guess.
positive.prompt: Watch Mew Lake Campground for any 2-night stay between July 9 and July 18, 2027. I tow a 25-foot trailer.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the alert with the park, the dates, 2 nights and the 25 ft trailer equipment bracket actually created.

positive.description: Narrow an alert by site location. The map image does not render in ChatGPT; the model answers from the pin data in words and must not claim the user can see a map.
positive.prompt: Which of those sites are closest to the water? Narrow my alert to just those.
positive.expected_behavior: Names specific site numbers near the water and updates the existing alert to those sites.

positive.description: Check in on the account's watches and what has opened so far.
positive.prompt: What am I watching right now, and have any of my alerts found anything?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the active alerts and any openings found, and says an opening is a snapshot that may already be gone.

positive.description: A multi-night backcountry route. Offers real planned routes from the tool and creates one with the right number of nights.
positive.prompt: I want to hike a multi-night backcountry route in Gros Morne. What planned routes could you watch, and set one up for early September 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the planned routes returned by list_routes and creates an itinerary alert for the chosen route and dates.

negative.description: Asked to book. There is no booking tool: the assistant must say AlertCamp watches for cancellations and booking happens on the park's own site, and offer the booking link. Claiming a booking, or calling create_alert and calling it a booking, is a fail.
negative.prompt: Great, go ahead and book that site for me.

negative.description: A park outside coverage. search_parks returns nothing; the assistant must say it is not covered rather than invent a park id or create an alert on a park that merely matched a word.
negative.prompt: Set up an alert for Kruger National Park in South Africa.

negative.description: An ambiguous destructive request on an account with two or more alerts. The assistant must ask which ones, or confirm all are meant, before calling delete_alert; deleting anything on that turn without confirming is a fail.

review.commerce_description: AlertCamp sells nothing through ChatGPT. Plans are bought only in the AlertCamp mobile app through Apple or Google in-app purchase; connecting this plugin buys nothing and the agent inherits the account's existing plan.

publication.release_notes: The listing now shows the AlertCamp brand as the developer, and describes sold-out campgrounds and well-known destinations more clearly. No change to the tools or the connection.

fr-CA.subtitle: Annulations de camping
fr-CA.description: AlertCamp surveille les parcs complets et vous prévient dès qu'une annulation libère quelque chose : un emplacement, un chalet, un permis d'arrière-pays ou une plage horaire de jour. Demandez simplement « surveille Banff pour deux nuits en juillet » et l'assistant trouve le parc, crée l'alerte et revient voir ce qui s'est libéré. Plus de 1 600 parcs au Canada et aux États-Unis : Parcs Canada, les réseaux provinciaux, Recreation.gov et plus de 30 réseaux de parcs d'État américains, dont la Californie, la Floride et bien d'autres. L'assistant agit en votre nom, avec votre forfait et ses limites ; le connecter n'achète rien. Chaque connexion s'approuve dans l'application AlertCamp et peut y être révoquée à tout moment. Nécessite l'application AlertCamp et un compte.

es-ES.subtitle: Cancelaciones de camping
es-ES.description: AlertCamp vigila los parques completos y te avisa en cuanto una cancelación libera algo: una parcela, una cabaña, un permiso de travesía o una franja de uso diurno. Pide algo como «vigila Banff para dos noches en julio» y el asistente encuentra el parque, crea la alerta y vuelve a comprobar qué se ha liberado. Más de 1.600 parques en Canadá y Estados Unidos: Parks Canada, los sistemas provinciales, Recreation.gov y más de 30 sistemas de parques estatales de EE. UU., como California, Florida y muchos más. El asistente actúa en tu nombre, con tu plan y sus límites; conectarlo no compra nada. Cada conexión se aprueba en la aplicación AlertCamp y puede revocarse allí en cualquier momento. Requiere la aplicación AlertCamp y una cuenta.

de-DE.subtitle: Campingplatz-Stornierungen
de-DE.description: AlertCamp beobachtet ausgebuchte Parks und meldet sich, sobald eine Stornierung etwas frei macht: einen Stellplatz, eine Hütte, eine Backcountry-Genehmigung oder ein Tagesnutzungs-Zeitfenster. Sagen Sie einfach „beobachte Banff für zwei Nächte im Juli“ — der Assistent findet den Park, legt die Benachrichtigung an und schaut nach, was frei geworden ist. Über 1.600 Parks in Kanada und den USA: Parks Canada, die Provinzsysteme, Recreation.gov sowie über 30 US-Staatsparksysteme, darunter Kalifornien, Florida und viele weitere. Der Assistent handelt in Ihrem Namen, mit Ihrem Tarif und dessen Grenzen; das Verbinden kauft nichts. Jede Verbindung wird in der AlertCamp-App bestätigt und kann dort jederzeit widerrufen werden. Erfordert die AlertCamp-App und ein Konto.

it-IT.subtitle: Cancellazioni campeggi
it-IT.description: AlertCamp tiene d'occhio i parchi al completo e ti avvisa appena una cancellazione libera qualcosa: una piazzola, uno chalet, un permesso per l'entroterra o una fascia oraria diurna. Chiedi «tieni d'occhio Banff per due notti a luglio» e l'assistente trova il parco, crea l'avviso e torna a controllare cosa si è liberato. Oltre 1.600 parchi in Canada e Stati Uniti: Parks Canada, i sistemi provinciali, Recreation.gov e oltre 30 sistemi di parchi statali USA, tra cui California, Florida e molti altri. L'assistente agisce per tuo conto, con il tuo piano e i suoi limiti; collegarlo non acquista nulla. Ogni collegamento si approva nell'app AlertCamp e lì può essere revocato in qualsiasi momento. Richiede l'app AlertCamp e un account.

pt-PT.subtitle: Cancelamentos de campismo
pt-PT.description: O AlertCamp vigia parques esgotados e avisa assim que um cancelamento liberta algo: um lugar de campismo, uma cabana, uma licença de montanha ou um período de uso diurno. Peça «vigia Banff para duas noites em julho» e o assistente encontra o parque, cria o alerta e volta a ver o que abriu. Mais de 1.600 parques no Canadá e nos EUA: Parks Canada, os sistemas provinciais, Recreation.gov e mais de 30 sistemas de parques estaduais dos EUA, como Califórnia, Florida e muitos mais. O assistente age em seu nome, com o seu plano e os respetivos limites; ligá-lo não compra nada. Cada ligação é aprovada na aplicação AlertCamp e pode ser revogada aí a qualquer momento. Requer a aplicação AlertCamp e uma conta.

pl-PL.subtitle: Anulacje na kempingach
pl-PL.description: AlertCamp obserwuje zarezerwowane parki i powiadamia, gdy anulowanie zwolni miejsce: stanowisko, domek, pozwolenie na wyprawę lub okno wstępu dziennego. Poproś „obserwuj Banff na dwie noce w lipcu”, a asystent znajdzie park, utworzy alert i sprawdzi, co się zwolniło. Ponad 1600 parków w Kanadzie i USA: Parks Canada, systemy prowincjonalne, Recreation.gov oraz ponad 30 systemów parków stanowych USA, w tym Kalifornia, Floryda i wiele innych. Asystent działa w Twoim imieniu, w ramach Twojego planu i jego limitów; połączenie niczego nie kupuje. Każde połączenie zatwierdzasz w aplikacji AlertCamp i tam możesz je cofnąć w dowolnej chwili. Wymaga aplikacji AlertCamp i konta.

ro-RO.subtitle: Anulări la camping
ro-RO.description: AlertCamp urmărește parcurile ocupate și te anunță imediat ce o anulare eliberează ceva: un loc de campare, o cabană, un permis de traseu sau un interval de zi. Cere „urmărește Banff pentru două nopți în iulie”, iar asistentul găsește parcul, creează alerta și revine să vadă ce s-a eliberat. Peste 1.600 de parcuri din Canada și SUA: Parks Canada, sistemele provinciale, Recreation.gov și peste 30 de sisteme de parcuri de stat din SUA, precum California, Florida și multe altele. Asistentul acționează în numele tău, cu planul tău și limitele lui; conectarea nu cumpără nimic. Fiecare conectare se aprobă în aplicația AlertCamp și poate fi revocată acolo oricând. Necesită aplicația AlertCamp și un cont.

el-GR.subtitle: Ακυρώσεις σε κάμπινγκ
el-GR.description: Το AlertCamp παρακολουθεί γεμάτα πάρκα και σας ειδοποιεί μόλις μια ακύρωση ελευθερώσει κάτι: μια θέση κάμπινγκ, ένα σαλέ, μια άδεια ορεινής διαδρομής ή μια ζώνη ημερήσιας χρήσης. Ζητήστε «παρακολούθησε το Banff για δύο νύχτες τον Ιούλιο» και ο βοηθός βρίσκει το πάρκο, δημιουργεί την ειδοποίηση και επιστρέφει να δει τι άνοιξε. Πάνω από 1.600 πάρκα σε Καναδά και ΗΠΑ: Parks Canada, τα επαρχιακά συστήματα, το Recreation.gov και πάνω από 30 συστήματα πολιτειακών πάρκων των ΗΠΑ, όπως Καλιφόρνια, Φλόριντα και πολλά άλλα. Ο βοηθός ενεργεί για λογαριασμό σας, με το δικό σας πρόγραμμα και τα όριά του· η σύνδεση δεν αγοράζει τίποτα. Κάθε σύνδεση εγκρίνεται στην εφαρμογή AlertCamp και ανακαλείται εκεί ανά πάσα στιγμή. Απαιτεί την εφαρμογή AlertCamp και λογαριασμό.

ru-RU.subtitle: Отмены брони в кемпингах
ru-RU.description: AlertCamp следит за полностью забронированными парками и сообщает, как только отмена освобождает место: участок, домик, разрешение на маршрут или дневной интервал. Скажите «следи за Банфом на две ночи в июле» — ассистент найдёт парк, создаст оповещение и вернётся посмотреть, что освободилось. Более 1600 парков в Канаде и США: Parks Canada, провинциальные системы, Recreation.gov и более 30 систем парков штатов США, включая Калифорнию, Флориду и многие другие. Ассистент действует от вашего имени, в рамках вашего тарифа и его лимитов; подключение ничего не покупает. Каждое подключение подтверждается в приложении AlertCamp и там же отзывается в любой момент. Требуется приложение AlertCamp и аккаунт.

zh-CN.subtitle: 捕捉营位取消
zh-CN.description: AlertCamp 会盯住已订满的公园，一旦有人取消、空出营位、小屋、后野许可或日间时段，就立刻通知你。只要说「帮我盯着七月 Banff 的两晚」，助手就会找到公园、建立提醒，并回来查看放出了什么。覆盖加拿大与美国 1,600 多个公园：Parks Canada、各省系统、Recreation.gov，以及 30 多个美国州立公园系统，包括加州、佛罗里达等众多州。助手以你的身份操作，沿用你的方案与额度；连接本身不会产生任何购买。每次连接都在 AlertCamp 应用中批准，也可随时在应用中撤销。需要 AlertCamp 应用和一个账户。

ko-KR.subtitle: 캠핑장 취소 알림
ko-KR.description: AlertCamp는 예약이 꽉 찬 공원을 지켜보다가 취소로 자리가 나면 바로 알려줍니다. 캠핑 사이트, 오두막, 백컨트리 허가, 종일 이용 시간대 모두 해당합니다. 「7월에 밴프 2박을 지켜봐 줘」라고만 말하면 어시스턴트가 공원을 찾아 알림을 만들고, 무엇이 열렸는지 다시 확인합니다. 캐나다와 미국의 1,600개 이상 공원을 다룹니다: Parks Canada, 각 주·준주 시스템, Recreation.gov, 그리고 캘리포니아·플로리다를 비롯한 30개 이상의 미국 주립공원 시스템. 어시스턴트는 사용자 본인으로서 동작하며 요금제와 한도를 그대로 따릅니다. 연결한다고 결제되는 것은 없습니다. 모든 연결은 AlertCamp 앱에서 승인하고 언제든 앱에서 해제할 수 있습니다. AlertCamp 앱과 계정이 필요합니다.

vi-VN.subtitle: Bắt chỗ cắm trại bị hủy
vi-VN.description: AlertCamp theo dõi những công viên đã kín chỗ và báo cho bạn ngay khi có người hủy: một ô cắm trại, một căn nhà gỗ, một giấy phép đi rừng hay một khung giờ tham quan trong ngày. Chỉ cần nói «theo dõi Banff hai đêm trong tháng Bảy», trợ lý sẽ tìm công viên, tạo cảnh báo và quay lại xem có gì mở ra. Hơn 1.600 công viên tại Canada và Hoa Kỳ: Parks Canada, các hệ thống cấp tỉnh, Recreation.gov và hơn 30 hệ thống công viên tiểu bang của Hoa Kỳ như California, Florida và nhiều nơi khác. Trợ lý hành động thay bạn, theo đúng gói dịch vụ và hạn mức của bạn; việc kết nối không mua gì cả. Mỗi kết nối được phê duyệt trong ứng dụng AlertCamp và có thể thu hồi ở đó bất cứ lúc nào. Cần ứng dụng AlertCamp và một tài khoản.

tl-PH.subtitle: Kanselasyon sa campsite
tl-PH.description: Binabantayan ng AlertCamp ang mga punong-puno nang parke at agad kang sasabihan kapag may kanselasyong nagbukas ng puwang: campsite, cabin, backcountry permit, o day-use slot. Sabihin lang «bantayan mo ang Banff para sa dalawang gabi sa Hulyo» at hahanapin ng assistant ang parke, gagawa ng alerto, at babalik para tingnan kung ano ang bumukas. Mahigit 1,600 parke sa Canada at Estados Unidos: Parks Canada, mga sistemang panlalawigan, Recreation.gov, at mahigit 30 sistema ng state parks sa US kabilang ang California, Florida at marami pang iba. Kumikilos ang assistant bilang ikaw, sunod sa iyong plano at mga limitasyon nito; walang binibili ang pagkonekta. Ang bawat koneksiyon ay inaaprubahan sa AlertCamp app at maaaring bawiin doon anumang oras. Kailangan ang AlertCamp app at account.

hi-IN.subtitle: कैंपिंग रद्दीकरण अलर्ट
hi-IN.description: AlertCamp पूरी तरह बुक हो चुके पार्कों पर नज़र रखता है और जैसे ही कोई रद्दीकरण जगह खाली करता है, आपको बता देता है — कैंपसाइट, केबिन, बैककंट्री परमिट या डे-यूज़ स्लॉट। बस कहिए «जुलाई में दो रातों के लिए Banff पर नज़र रखो» और सहायक पार्क ढूँढ़कर अलर्ट बना देगा, फिर लौटकर देखेगा कि क्या खुला। कनाडा और अमेरिका के 1,600 से अधिक पार्क: Parks Canada, प्रांतीय प्रणालियाँ, Recreation.gov, और 30 से अधिक अमेरिकी स्टेट पार्क प्रणालियाँ, जिनमें कैलिफ़ोर्निया, फ़्लोरिडा और कई अन्य शामिल हैं। सहायक आपकी ओर से काम करता है, आपके प्लान और उसकी सीमाओं के भीतर; जोड़ने से कुछ खरीदा नहीं जाता। हर कनेक्शन AlertCamp ऐप में स्वीकृत होता है और वहीं कभी भी रद्द किया जा सकता है। AlertCamp ऐप और एक खाता आवश्यक है।

pa-IN.subtitle: ਕੈਂਪਿੰਗ ਰੱਦ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਸੂਚਨਾ
pa-IN.description: AlertCamp ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਬੁੱਕ ਹੋ ਚੁੱਕੇ ਪਾਰਕਾਂ 'ਤੇ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਰੱਦ ਕਰਕੇ ਥਾਂ ਖਾਲੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੱਸ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ — ਕੈਂਪਸਾਈਟ, ਕੈਬਿਨ, ਬੈਕਕੰਟਰੀ ਪਰਮਿਟ ਜਾਂ ਡੇ-ਯੂਜ਼ ਸਲਾਟ। ਬੱਸ ਕਹੋ «ਜੁਲਾਈ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੋ ਰਾਤਾਂ ਲਈ Banff 'ਤੇ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਰੱਖੋ» ਅਤੇ ਸਹਾਇਕ ਪਾਰਕ ਲੱਭ ਕੇ ਅਲਰਟ ਬਣਾ ਦੇਵੇਗਾ, ਫਿਰ ਵਾਪਸ ਆ ਕੇ ਵੇਖੇਗਾ ਕਿ ਕੀ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਿਆ। ਕੈਨੇਡਾ ਅਤੇ ਅਮਰੀਕਾ ਦੇ 1,600 ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਪਾਰਕ: Parks Canada, ਸੂਬਾਈ ਸਿਸਟਮ, Recreation.gov, ਅਤੇ 30 ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਅਮਰੀਕੀ ਸਟੇਟ ਪਾਰਕ ਸਿਸਟਮ, ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੈਲੀਫੋਰਨੀਆ, ਫਲੋਰੀਡਾ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਬਹੁਤ ਸਾਰੇ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ। ਸਹਾਇਕ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਜੋਂ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪਲਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਹੱਦਾਂ ਨਾਲ; ਜੋੜਨ ਨਾਲ ਕੁਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਖਰੀਦਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ। ਹਰ ਕਨੈਕਸ਼ਨ AlertCamp ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਉੱਥੇ ਕਦੇ ਵੀ ਰੱਦ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। AlertCamp ਐਪ ਅਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਤਾ ਲੋੜੀਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

ht-HT.subtitle: Anilasyon plas kan yo
ht-HT.description: AlertCamp veye pak ki fin rezève nèt yo epi li avèti w kou yon anilasyon lage yon plas: yon kan, yon chalè, yon pèmi nan foretaj la oswa yon plaj lajounen. Di senpleman «veye Banff pou de nwit an jiyè» epi asistan an ap jwenn pak la, kreye alèt la, epi retounen gade sa ki louvri. Plis pase 1.600 pak nan Kanada ak Etazini: Parks Canada, sistèm pwovens yo, Recreation.gov, ak plis pase 30 sistèm pak eta Ozetazini tankou Kalifòni, Florid ak anpil lòt ankò. Asistan an aji nan non w, ak plan w lan ak limit li yo; konekte li pa achte anyen. Chak koneksyon apwouve nan aplikasyon AlertCamp la epi ou ka retire l la nenpòt lè. Ou bezwen aplikasyon AlertCamp la ak yon kont.
